item.title: Show HN: NES Contra (1987) port (ASM –> C and then C –> WebAssembly)
item.description: Based on vermiceli's annotated disassembly of Contra: https://github.com/vermiceli/nes-contra-us . Thanks for the great work. I ported it in two steps. First to C: the game logic is translated routine by routine from the 6502 assembly, and checked frame by frame against the original in the Mesen emulator. Then the C code to WebAssembly so it runs in the browser. The cherry on top: online multiplayer, so two players can play co-op over the internet. Source: https://github.com/epoyraz/nes-contra-us Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50319169 Points: 31 # Comments: 18 Fuente: Hacker News - Portada.
